class.name: VoxelLoadTrigger4D
class.brief_description: A position around which voxel chunks are kept loaded.
class.description: VoxelLoadTrigger4D marks a position around which a [VoxelWorld4D] keeps voxel chunks loaded. It is usually attached to the player, but can follow anything that should have terrain generated around it. Chunks within [member load_distance] of the trigger's position are loaded. Loaded chunks are only unloaded once they are farther away than [member load_distance] times [member unload_distance_ratio], so that chunks near the boundary are not repeatedly loaded and unloaded as the trigger moves around. By default a trigger applies to every VoxelWorld4D in the scene tree; set [member voxel_world_path] to restrict it to one specific world.

members.member: The distance within which voxel chunks are loaded around this trigger.
The ratio of the unload distance to [member load_distance]. Loaded chunks are unloaded once they are farther away than [member load_distance] times this ratio.
The [VoxelWorld4D] this trigger applies to. When empty, the default, the trigger applies to every VoxelWorld4D in the scene tree.
